title: move's clause-left-behind line counts the sprint's review and goal research stories as carriers, so it stays silent
goal: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-x5gjv4r7, item ST-ifljijni: bl_land.clauses_left_behind treats the sprint's review story and goal research story as carriers of a goal clause, while goal_clause_lines (close --summary) leaves them out, so move --sprint none prints no 'goal clause left' line when the research story's goal shares the clause's words (on SP-x5gjv4r7 it returned [] for ST-732j5ufa, ST-xuhig3u6, ST-ifljijni and ST-mti4zrzz). clauses_left_behind leaves out the review and goal_research stories as goal_clause_lines does.

run:
import sys,types;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land
it={'SP-a':{'kind':'sprint','goal':'ops prints a sprint operational rows; the beta writer works'},
 'ST-r':{'kind':'story','status':'done','goal_research':True,'title':'Research sprint goal','goal':'which operational rows ops prints for a sprint','sprint':'SP-a'},
 'ST-o':{'kind':'story','status':'todo','title':'ops prints operational rows','goal':'ops prints a sprint operational rows','sprint':'SP-a'}}
bl=types.SimpleNamespace(items=it,sprint_items=lambda s:[i for i,d in it.items() if d.get('sprint')==s],descendants=lambda i:[])
left=bl_land.clauses_left_behind(bl,'SP-a','ST-o');print('left behind:',left)
sys.exit(0 if left==['ops prints a sprint operational rows'] else 1)
